meta.name: Demonstration catalogue
meta.disclaimer: Part numbers, prices and bin locations in this file are illustrative demo data for a shop's own catalogue. Replace them with your verified supplier/EPC data before selling anything. The identification engine never treats this file as an authoritative parts database.

technical_notes: Push-fit into the right bank valve cover; lubricate the O-ring with clean engine oil before seating.
Common symptoms of failure: rough idle, oil in the intake tube, whistling at idle, P0171/P0507 codes.
Check the PCV hose for cracks while replacing - a split hose mimics a failed valve.
Integral ABS wheel-speed sensor - do not reuse a damaged connector pigtail.
Axle nut is torque-to-yield on some applications; fit a new nut and torque to spec (approx. 240 Nm) with the vehicle on the ground.
Failure symptoms: humming/growling that changes with vehicle speed and swerves when loaded side to side.
Always replace in axle pairs where budget allows; inspect the knuckle bore for corrosion before pressing in.
Roller follower runs on a dedicated camshaft lobe - inspect the lobe for scoring before fitting a new pump.
High-pressure line is single-use on most GDI applications; never reuse the flare fitting.
Failure symptoms: extended crank, P0087/P008A low fuel pressure codes, misfire under load, fuel smell in oil.
Cleanliness is critical: any debris in the delivery line will destroy the new pump.
Most common Pentastar valvetrain failure: the roller needle bearing walks out and destroys the cam lobe.
Replace the matched lash adjuster if the plunger is not free or the arm shows heat discolouration.
Classic symptom: loud top-end tick on cold start that fades as oil pressure builds.
Sold individually - count 24 per bank set for a full V6.
